consumer: The engine's dialogue/condition possession predicate (u_has_items via set_has_items), asking 'does the character actor have 1st_aid?'
scope: only the character's own carried items (on-person inventory/wielded/worn, the reach of actor->has_amount/has_charges) -- not nearby or map inventory
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::set_has_items -- its body builds a lambda returning actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count) over the alpha/beta character, i.e. an engine-computed yes/no possession check
divergence: A 1st_aid nested inside a held gun's or magazine's contents: the engine's has_amount predicate still counts it as held, but a re-derivation from carried_items[] would miss it because visit_internal stops at guns/magazines, so the two answers diverge
